"""Scratch (not committed): the W2-91 checks against an in-memory stand-in of the intended path map change."""
import copy
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-91-tests/tests/acceptance/W2-91")
import w2_91_support as s  # noqa: E402
import test_w2_91_full_embeddings as t  # noqa: E402

base = s.namespaces_at(None)
head = copy.deepcopy(base)
head["root-files"]["embedding_policy"] = "embedded"
head["project-overlay"]["embedding_policy"] = "embedded"
carried = head.pop("carried-code")
head["carried-code"] = {**carried, "paths": ["cli/**"]}
head["schemas"] = {**carried, "paths": ["schemas/**"], "embedding_policy": "embedded"}

paths = s.tracked()
print("not_yet_embedded", t.not_yet_embedded(head, paths)[:5])
print("stays_out", t.embedded_that_stays_out(head, paths + list(t.PROBES)))
print("schemas_cli", t.schemas_sharing_with_cli(head, paths + list(t.PROBES)))
print("overlay", t.overlay_not_restricted(head, [p for p in paths if p.startswith("governance/")]))
print("values", t.values_outside_the_two(head))
print("moved", t.moved(base, head, paths)[:5])
print("homes != 1", [p for p in paths if len(s.homes(head, p)) != 1][:5])

if not s.lacking():
    server = s.OllamaStandIn()
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            files = {rel: t._text(rel) for rel in t.IN + t.OUT + t.CONTROLS}
            project = s.plant(Path(folder) / "project", head, files)
            s.rebuild(project, server.host)
            chunked, vectors = s.store_paths(project)
            print("IN without vector", sorted(set(t.IN) - vectors))
            print("OUT with vector", sorted(vectors & set(t.OUT)))
            print("exact", vectors == {rel for rel in chunked if s.embedded(head, rel)})
    finally:
        server.close()
